aguas-claras.statement: Afro-Caribbean music nights, cacao ceremonies and regional cooking classes are part of the programme.
aguas-claras.source: Aguas Claras record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

aguas-claras.statement: The Papaya kitchen sources locally, and the property describes waste-reduction practices and support for nearby villages.
aguas-claras.source: Aguas Claras record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

angama-mara.statement: A Beading Studio at the lodge is run by Maasai women; a one-acre Shamba garden supplies lunch.
angama-mara.source: Angama Mara conservation ledger, James Wild & Co Ledger record copy

angama-mara.statement: The Angama Foundation is funded by a US$20 per person per night guest donation.
angama-mara.source: Angama Mara conservation ledger, James Wild & Co Ledger record copy

angama-mara.statement: The Angama Foundation, set up in 2015 and funded by a per-person, per-night guest donation, has built classrooms and early-childhood rooms at Partakilat Primary, supplied desks, backpacks and water tanks to local schools, and runs a scholarship programme for Saparingo Primary graduates.
angama-mara.source: Angama Mara conservation ledger, James Wild & Co Ledger record copy

angama-mara.statement: A community and staff clinic at the lodge is staffed by a full-time medical officer.
angama-mara.source: Angama Mara conservation ledger, James Wild & Co Ledger record copy

angama-mara.statement: Predator-proof bomas with the Anne K. Taylor Fund, an anti-poaching vehicle for rhino monitoring with the Mara Conservancy, and elephant collaring with the Mara Elephant Project.
angama-mara.source: Angama Mara conservation ledger, James Wild & Co Ledger record copy

cottars-1920-camp.statement: Named community programmes and how the conservancy lease benefits Maasai landowners are pending confirmation with the camp.
The camp sits on a 7,608-acre private conservancy beside the Maasai Mara, run by a family with over a century of safari heritage and a stated conservation-driven purpose.
cottars-1920-camp.source: Cottar's 1920s Camp record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

singita-faru-faru-lodge.statement: The lodge lists conservation and community impact among its features; the Grumeti Fund's work is pending confirmation for a named statement.
singita-faru-faru-lodge.source: Singita Faru Faru record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

jacis-private-lodge.statement: Staff own a share of the business through the Jaci's Staff Trust.
jacis-private-lodge.source: Jaci's Private Lodge record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

jacis-private-lodge.statement: Staff own 27.2% of the business through the Jaci's Staff Trust.
jacis-private-lodge.source: Jaci's Private Lodge record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

kwando-lagoon.statement: Kwando describes itself as a pioneer of photographic tourism in Botswana, with guest stays contributing to the conservation of the Linyanti wilderness; named programmes are pending confirmation.
kwando-lagoon.source: Kwando Lagoon record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

wilderness-mombo-luxury-camp.statement: The camp lists a community conservation partnership and runs on solar power.
wilderness-mombo-luxury-camp.source: Mombo record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

wilderness-mombo-luxury-camp.statement: Botswana concession fees and any guest conservation levy are pending confirmation.

monwana-thornybush.statement: Whether a Thornybush reserve conservation levy is charged per guest night, and what it funds, is pending confirmation from the lodge.

ngala-safari-lodge-by-beyond.statement: The lodge states that conservation initiatives and community engagement are at the heart of the experience; specific programmes are pending confirmation with &Beyond.
ngala-safari-lodge-by-beyond.source: Ngala record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

wilderness-qorokwe.statement: The camp is fully solar powered, in a private concession bordering Moremi.
wilderness-qorokwe.source: Wilderness Qorokwe record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

tswalu-reserve.statement: The Tswalu Foundation's research and community programmes are on the house's list to verify directly with the reserve.
One of the few places to see desert-adapted black rhino, black-maned Kalahari lion and pangolin.
tswalu-reserve.source: Tswalu record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger

tswalu-reserve.statement: Tswalu describes itself as a regeneration project: South Africa's largest private reserve, run with a small number of guests so that every stay gives back to the land.
tswalu-reserve.source: Tswalu record copy, James Wild & Co Ledger
